answer: Reputation is a scarce, unforgeable resource earned by consistently passing originality checks, and the economy spends it to filter out Sybil clusters before they can compound into a majority. In practice this means a farm must spend real resources on every single alias, and that per-identity cost is what keeps the network honest at scale.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a quill as the anchor of the cost.
